cases.name: all-field-types-flow-through
cases.note: Exercises the schema-driven Set-node field typing. StartEvent (webhook) → EndEvent (Set) with six typed fields — one per SBPA JSON-Schema type: string, number, array-of-string, array-of-number, object, array-of-object. The Map() formula shaping the last one becomes an n8n .map() expression. `astring` is the literal `"asdf"` per the SBPA mapping; every other field flows through from the payload. `expectResult` deep-subset-matches the EndEvent's output — if the schema-typing feature ever regresses (e.g. type: 'object' on a scalar), n8n's coercion would corrupt these values and the match would fail.
